scripts.dev: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if ($p) { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; if (Test-Path frontend/.next/BUILD_ID) { Remove-Item -Path frontend/.next -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"; npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.dev:erp: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if ($p) { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; if (Test-Path frontend/.next/BUILD_ID) { Remove-Item -Path frontend/.next -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"; npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.dev:clean: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if ($p) { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"; npm --prefix frontend run dev:clean
scripts.api: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-Process UabIndia.Api -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"; dotnet run --project Backend/src/UabIndia.Api/UabIndia.Api.csproj --urls http://127.0.0.1:5000
